caption: The drawing depicts a lidded vessel, possibly a sugar bowl, with two handles, rendered in pencil on a light-colored background. The vessel has a rounded body with a slightly flared base and a domed lid topped with a finial. There are two symmetrical, angular handles on either side of the vessel. The surface of the vessel is shaded to indicate its metallic texture and curved form, and the front displays a monogram consisting of the letters "MH." In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, inset technical sketch of the same vessel, which includes measurements: the width from handle to handle is listed as 7 1/4 inches, and the height to the top of the finial is 5 1/4 inches. Both the large and small images are enclosed within simple rectangular borders. The entire drawing uses shades of gray from pencil lines and shading, with no additional colors present.
title: Silver Sugar Bowl
